tests.note: Re-measured 2026-11-11 on the final adversarial-pass tree (6d08cc8a): Ran 4033 tests in 1298.016s, OK (skipped=12), exit 0. The previous record (3523 at b1913af7) predates the store, the pack v3 work, the share surface and the CP-040 v3 desktop wave. The only failures this tree ever showed were eleven stale surface assertions and visual pins caused by adding the Workshop Share tab and by the store shelf growing; each was fixed by updating the assertion or re-recording the proof, never by relaxing a gate. store_verify now also refuses a pack whose licence does not grant redistribution, so the shelf is red until the 1.0.1 update in pull request #2 replaces the fixture pack merged earlier.

rpc.note: re-asserted by the supervisor on master at b1913af7 (the CP-052 merge over eaf2d41): contracts/rpc.v26.json declares 93 methods and 93 handlers and `x-supersedes` names contracts/rpc.v25.json; coursebook/contracts.py WIRE_CONTRACT_VERSION = 26; a probe importing every registering module reports 93 implemented methods, no declared method lacking a handler and no handler outside the contract. v26 is one additive amendment over v25 (CP-052): `$defs/world_brief` gains one **optional** `route_anchors` array of `{anchor_id, section_id, x, y}` entries with x/y numbers in 0-1, so a brief that declares no anchors keeps its exact v25 shape and bytes, and no method, request shape, existing required key, error code, job kind or vocabulary value moves. The read side was the defect: world.read.response.world.oneOf collapsed the real brief into "not valid under any of the given schemas" for a stored plate with anchors, and the write side silently dropped the field on every world.generate. rpc.v25.json stays byte-identical on disk as immutable history, and the wire echoes (`contract_version` on both response envelopes and health.get) move 25 -> 26. The record's previous v25 / 93 methods measured on 07976d8 and v24 / 83 before it stay in the immutable history. A separate post-submission card (t_ed8e33c7) lands `library_item.created_at` as v27.
